title: Enchanted Magic Ring
description: A golden ring with intricate engravings rests on a dark surface. It features a large faceted purple gemstone glowing with swirling teal, yellow, and pink magic, surrounded by ethereal flames and dripping colorful liquid.
prompt: A highly detailed golden ring with ancient runes engraved on the band, featuring a large faceted hexagonal purple amethyst gemstone at its center. The gem glows with swirling colorful magic in teal, yellow, and pink hues, surrounded by ethereal blue and magenta flames and energy. Magical liquid in teal and pink drips from the gem onto the surface below. Dramatic dark background with strong rim lighting and glowing particles, cinematic fantasy style, moody atmosphere.
